_comment: THE WORKLIST IS CLOSED (task xytoltso, 2026-07-29). `placeholders` below
is empty and `./placeholder/` no longer exists. build.rs still derives
PLACEHOLDER_ICONS from that directory and still hard-errors if a file in
it shadows a real vendored icon, so re-creating it for a future gap works
exactly as before --- but nothing is a placeholder today, and nothing is
exempt from role substitution.
WHAT A PLACEHOLDER WAS. A stand-in for a chartsymbols.xml symbol with no
vendored quantenschaum equivalent, so the chart kept drawing the symbol
mid-migration. `icons::pack::render_with` short-circuited them past all
compositing and recolouring, which is why they could not follow the
theme --- the second half of the 'un-themed magenta' report.
HOW THE LAST 16 CLOSED. They were real HPGL geometry traced from
chartsymbols.xml, correct in every way except colour: the generator baked
the DAY palette's own S-52 tokens (CHBLK, CHGRD, CHMGD, CHMGF, LANDF,
CHBRN, DEPVS), and `icons::roles::ASSET_HEXES` has no entry for any of
them. xytoltso moved each paint value onto the hex the vendored artwork
beside it already uses for the same job, then moved the files into ./
proper. Geometry is byte-identical --- rendered before and after at 240px,
the alpha masks compare at AE 0 for all 16.
CHGRD  #7d898c  -> obj-grey      #808080  (FAIRWY51/52; new ASSET_HEXES entry)
CHMGD  #c545c3  -> warn-magenta  #ec008c  (the vendored TSS/furniture magenta)
CHMGF  #d3a6e9  -> warn-magenta  #ec008c
LANDF  #8b661f  -> art-ink       #231f20  (the vendored set contains no brown at all)
CHBRN  #b19139  -> art-ink       #231f20
DANGER01 took DANGER51/52/53's exact pair instead --- art-ink outline,
art-blue-pale #afcce3 fill --- because it is the same dotted danger
ellipse off the same OBSTRN branch and now sits beside them (task
ktrlvosw). qqqxqskl had already matched their size.
THEIR CANVASES DID NOT CHANGE and must not: each viewBox is inflated on
purpose to centre the presentation library's own PIVOT, which is why the
16 are listed in `icons::pack::TRACED_LITERAL_KEYS` and skip
`composite::stack`'s padding. `port-map.json`'s `gap` block is the
surviving record of where each one came from.
SCALE (qqqxqskl, 2026-07-29, before the above): every one of the 16 was
scaled x0.5. The generator emitted HPGL at ~1/25 of a chartsymbols unit;
the presentation library's own bitmap for the same symbol is ~1/32, so
the traces came out ~1.27x the official raster and ~2x the vendored set
the rest of the chart is drawn from. Regenerating one: scale the CONTENT,
not just the outer width/height --- chartcore normalises to the viewBox
user units (see ./no-anchor.svg).
